declared_at: 2026-10-14 (before any outcome in the holdout spans was computed for this rule)

rule.timeframe: H4 broker-time bucket with exactly 16 M15 children
rule.signal: body / (high - low) >= 0.66 on the closed H4 candle
rule.entry: first M15 OPEN within 120 min after the H4 close; E = open + spread 0.09 + entry slip 0.09
rule.stop: signal low - 0.2 x ATR14 (simple mean of 14 TR over complete H4 parents)
rule.target: TP = E + (1.5 x D + exit slip 0.09 + commission 0.08), D = E - SL + stop slip 0.09 + commission 0.08
rule.fills: stop first on a shared bar; a stop gapped at the open fills at the open
rule.funding: LONG -0.5759 USD/oz per broker midnight, Wednesday x3
rule.book: one position at a time; Account A INR 1,000,000 fixed risk INR 30,000; Account B INR 100,000 fixed risk INR 3,000; lots floored to 0.01, min 0.01, max 10

control: LONG on every complete H4 candle, identical entry/stop/target/book

data.clock: mt5_icmarkets_xau broker labels as-is (same as the parity runs)
data.excluded: 2026-07-06..2026-08-07 (rule was fitted there) and everything before 2026-05-22 (already seen)
data.exits: trades may run on later bars of the same file; still open at file end = UNRESOLVED, excluded from cash

pass_bar.primary: rule mean net R per settled book trade (Account A) > 0
pass_bar.secondary: rule Account A net INR > control Account A net INR
pass_bar.power: fewer than 30 settled Account A trades = INSUFFICIENT, no verdict
pass_bar.no_retune: one run; no threshold, target or window change after seeing the result

caveats: Long-only was chosen after seeing 2024-05..2026-05 results (shorts lost); that choice is not tested by this holdout.
The holdout months were already used as out-of-sample for other rules (H4 lower-wick 3R, H1 PDL sweep) in earlier sessions, not for this rule.
